summary_en: 192,000 shares of Japan Dry Chemical (ticker 1909) tendered to TCG2511 acquisition at ¥3,730/share. Total proceeds ¥716M, gain ¥683M. Tender closed 2026-06-29, settled 2026-07-06. Sakura Rubber held full stake, now zero. Gain to be recorded as special profit in Q1 FY3/27.
title_en: Notice of Tender Response to Public Acquisition and Recording of Special Profit
translation_en_brief: Sakura Rubber tendered all 192,000 shares of Japan Dry Chemical Co., Ltd. (ticker 1909) that it held to the public acquisition (tender offer) being conducted by TCG2511 Inc. The tender closed successfully on 2026-06-29. All shares were accepted and settled on 2026-07-06 at ¥3,730 per share, generating total proceeds of ¥716 million and a capital gain of ¥683 million. Following completion of the tender, Sakura Rubber's stake in Japan Dry Chemical is now zero. The ¥683 million gain will be recorded as special profit (特別利益) in the consolidated accounts for the first quarter of fiscal year ending March 2027.
